verdict_reason: Two P2 current-scope gaps were confirmed in the original snapshot. Parent later applied fixes; this receipt does not certify those edits or production admission.
intent: Read-only broker-UID Root scope preimage v2 verifies current grant/catalog/lease and wallet-acknowledged saved scope digest; exact Rust serde scope digest and no wallet calls. This grants no spending authority; begin remains decisive.

evidence: scope_preimage_v2 relies on _current, which checks grant expiry and stop.json but not finished.json or owner-revoked.json.
Normal stopped-worker observation calls _revoke_spending and writes finished.json without creating stop.json.
findings.suggested_fix: Refuse completed or owner-revoked attempts before returning the preimage, and test normal terminal observation as well as explicit stop/revocation.
findings.title: Refuse scope preimages after normal completion revokes the owner
findings.why_it_matters: The endpoint can return an apparently current scope preimage after normal completion has revoked that scope. Existing begin remains the spending gate, so this is not a demonstrated spending bypass.
source_detail_keys: security|clean-room/crates/execution/harness/linux_supervisor.py|934|refuse scope preimages after normal completion revokes the owner
findings.validation_reason: The saved original scope_preimage_v2 only calls _current, which checks stop.json and expiry, while the normal stopped-worker observe path writes owner-revoked.json and finished.json without stop.json; a completed grant with a still-current lease can therefore return its preimage. Current source lines 940-941 now reject both markers; this is a stale-read defect, not an established spending bypass, and incidence was not measured.

evidence: scope_preimage_v2 calls _current and _catalog, but validate_catalog checks scope and lease intervals and route hash without checking route currentness.
harness_spending.rs:218-220 defines wallet liveness as requiring both scope and route intervals.
findings.suggested_fix: Require the current time to fall within the route interval before return, with deterministic boundary tests.
findings.title: Reject scope preimages outside the reviewed route interval
findings.why_it_matters: The endpoint can return a preimage when its reviewed route is not yet valid or expired. Existing begin remains the spending gate, so this is not a demonstrated spending bypass.
source_detail_keys: correctness|clean-room/crates/execution/harness/linux_supervisor.py|934|reject scope preimages outside the reviewed route interval
findings.validation_reason: The saved original method and validate_catalog check scope/lease time and route hash but do not compare the current clock with route.valid_from_ms or valid_until_ms, while wallet AttemptScope.live requires the half-open route interval; a current lease with a future or expired route can return the preimage. Current source line 942 now checks the route interval; incidence was not measured and begin remains decisive.
